tasks.label: Agent: Run Hourly Cycle Loop
tasks.detail: Runs one pipeline cycle immediately, then repeats hourly (DRY_RUN safe). Stop with Ctrl+C or the trash icon in the terminal panel.

tasks.label: Agent: Run Once Now
tasks.detail: Single pipeline cycle, then exit - ideal for testing changes.

tasks.label: Agent: Install Dependencies
tasks.command: python -m venv .venv; .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install --upgrade pip; .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
